articles.title: Nifty faces 22,850 hurdle; analyst recommends BHEL, HAL, IndiGo for trade
articles.summary: An analyst has noted Nifty faces a significant resistance at 22,850, indicating potential market volatility. For trade, key recommendations include public sector undertakings BHEL and HAL, both vital to India's heavy engineering and aerospace/defence sectors, along with private airline IndiGo. This provides market insights and highlights major national companies' performance implications for aspirants monitoring economic trends.

articles.title: North Korea says it tested cruise missiles to be launched from sub
articles.summary: North Korea recently conducted test-fires of submarine-launched cruise missiles (SLCMs), asserting these were aimed at evaluating its underwater combat systems' readiness. This move signifies Pyongyang's ongoing efforts to enhance its naval capabilities and potentially expand its deterrent options. For SSB aspirants, this highlights continued regional military tensions and the strategic implications of advanced naval weapon development.
